title: x402 402 Payment Required Response
description: The body of an HTTP 402 response from an x402-compliant server. This schema is normative for x402 v1. Implementations MUST produce output that validates against this schema. Fields not defined here are extension points and MUST be ignored by conformant clients.

x402_version.description: Protocol version. MUST be 1 for x402 v1.

nonce.description: Single-use 32-byte nonce for the payment authorization. MUST be unique per challenge.

recipient.description: The address that receives the payment.

amount.description: Amount in smallest token unit (atomic), as a decimal string.

verifyingContract.description: Token contract that verifies the EIP-3009 authorization.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp after which this challenge is invalid.

settlement_mode.description: How the facilitator settles this payment.

free_tier_remaining.description: Calls remaining in the free tier for this client. If > 0, the client may retry without payment.

payment_intent_id.description: Server-generated idempotency key for this payment request.

tool.description: The tool or resource being paid for.

header.description: The HTTP header name for the payment payload (e.g., 'X-PAYMENT').

status_url.description: URL to poll for request status (for async settlements).
